title: On an ordinary day
body: Nothing happened today. I thought that was a perfectly good reason to leave you a note.
I hope there was at least one decent snack involved. If not, the day's management should be questioned.
Anyway. I'm glad you exist. That's all.

title: The distance thing
body: Almost three years is quite a long time to go without meeting someone and still have random things to tell them.
I didn't want to make this place about missing each other. I wanted it to be somewhere you could wander around and laugh a little.
But yes, occasionally I do miss the nonsense in person.

title: Dr. Maha, officially
body: Dear Doctor, the railway would like to congratulate you on possessing a doctorate and still being allowed to make questionable travel decisions.
Please note: this certificate entitles you to absolutely no free train tickets.
Regards, the management.

title: For a future filmmaker
body: You talk about seeing places and making travel videos. You don't have to become someone else's idea of a creator to do that.
Film a window. A street. The way a place sounds. Don't post it unless you want to.
Episode one can just be something you keep.

title: For a rubbish day
body: Some days aren't fixable with a clever sentence. I'm not going to pretend otherwise.
If this is one of those, you can close the website after this. Seriously.
The chai stall will still be here whenever.

title: A small thing
body: I used to think gifts had to be something you could wrap.
This one is a bunch of small things. Some silly, some quiet, some that might remind you of home.
You don't need to see everything. It's yours.

title: For much later
body: If you're reading this years after it was made, I wonder which station you're in.
Maybe half the jokes are terrible by now. That's honestly a reasonable possibility.
The part that matters hasn't changed: this place was made for you to use whenever you like.
